name: jit-inventory-sourcer
description: Just-in-time inventory sourcing: find lettable UK rentals (Rightmove, Zoopla, OnTheMarket, OpenRent) for enquiries where thesqua.re has no stock. Runs on Cloud Run (Node + Cloud SQL Postgres); also deployable as a Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.test: tsx test/smoke.ts && tsx test/ons.test.ts && tsx test/access-batch.test.ts && tsx test/filters.test.ts && tsx --experimental-sqlite test/db.test.ts && tsx --experimental-sqlite test/alerts.test.ts && tsx test/pg.test.ts
